verdict.rationale: The docs name official SDKs for Python, TypeScript and JavaScript (among others) that share the same resources and method names. They also document SDK trace ingestion, an OpenTelemetry exporter path, and a traces:write key for agent processes, so instrumenting apps in both ecosystems is a first-party capability. missing for 10: per-language SDK installation and instrumentation details (package names, auto-instrumentation or wrappers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Python and JS/TS SDKs.
